All Known Implementing Classes:
OperationTypeImpl
public interface OperationType extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject
A representation of the model object 'Operation Type'.

The following features are supported:

  • Signature
  • Name
  • Return Type
  • Modifiers
  • Parameter Types
